Title: GET /posts under load returns status 200 in under 3 seconds with no error
Preconditions: The demo service https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 5 threads, 10 s ramp-up, 60 s (`scripts/run.sh load`). Report run: 3 threads, 3 s ramp-up, 20 s (`-Jthreads=3 -Jrampup=3 -Jduration=20`)
Steps: 1. Run the plan `load.jmx` in non-GUI mode. 2. Read the results of the sampler "TC_LOAD_01 - GET /posts".
Expected Result: Every sample of the sampler passes its assertions (status 200, duration under 3000 ms): 0 errors.
